results.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  col_quebec,
  col_delta
FROM tbl_zulu
WHERE col_delta = 'L12'
ORDER BY col_quebec
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT z.col_quebec
FROM tbl_zulu z
JOIN tbl_juliet j ON j.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
WHERE j.col_papa = 'Ni'
ORDER BY z.col_quebec
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT col_quebec, col_falcon
FROM tbl_zulu
WHERE col_falcon < 4
ORDER BY col_falcon ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT tbl_zulu.col_quebec, tbl_delta.col_iris
FROM tbl_delta
JOIN tbl_zulu ON tbl_delta.col_rhea = tbl_zulu.col_rhea
WHERE tbl_delta.col_iris IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY tbl_delta.col_iris DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS convex_hull_compound_count
FROM tbl_delta
WHERE col_hotel = TRUE
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT tbl_zulu.col_quebec, tbl_delta.col_luna
FROM tbl_delta
JOIN tbl_zulu ON tbl_delta.col_rhea = tbl_zulu.col_rhea
WHERE tbl_delta.col_luna < -0.5
ORDER BY tbl_delta.col_luna ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  col_papa AS element,
  COUNT(DISTINCT col_rhea) AS entry_count
FROM tbl_juliet
GROUP BY col_papa
ORDER BY entry_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    z.col_quebec,
    d.col_luna
FROM tbl_zulu z
JOIN tbl_delta d ON d.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
WHERE
    d.col_hotel = TRUE
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM tbl_juliet j
        WHERE j.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
          AND j.col_papa = 'Al'
    )
ORDER BY d.col_luna ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  tbl_zulu.col_halo AS crystal_system,
  AVG(tbl_delta.col_luna) AS avg_eform
FROM tbl_zulu
JOIN tbl_delta ON tbl_delta.col_rhea = tbl_zulu.col_rhea
GROUP BY tbl_zulu.col_halo
ORDER BY avg_formation_energy ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS metastable_compound_count
FROM tbl_delta
WHERE col_hotel = false
  AND col_xenon < 0.05
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT z.col_quebec
FROM tbl_zulu z
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM tbl_juliet j_ni
    WHERE j_ni.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
      AND j_ni.col_papa = 'Ni'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM tbl_juliet j_al
    WHERE j_al.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
      AND j_al.col_papa = 'Al'
)
ORDER BY z.col_quebec
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT z.col_quebec, j.col_papa, d.col_luna
FROM tbl_zulu z
JOIN tbl_delta d ON d.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
JOIN tbl_juliet j ON j.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
WHERE j.col_zulu = 'A-site'
  AND j.col_papa = 'Co'
ORDER BY d.col_luna ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  tbl_zulu.col_quebec,
  tbl_zulu.col_apollo,
  tbl_delta.col_iris
FROM tbl_zulu
JOIN tbl_delta ON tbl_delta.col_rhea = tbl_zulu.col_rhea
WHERE tbl_zulu.col_apollo = 221
  AND tbl_delta.col_iris > 0
ORDER BY tbl_delta.col_iris DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  col_papa,
  col_uniform,
  col_gemini
FROM tbl_victor
ORDER BY col_uniform DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  j.col_papa,
  AVG(d.col_xenon) AS avg_hull_distance
FROM tbl_juliet AS j
JOIN tbl_zulu AS z ON j.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
JOIN tbl_delta AS d ON d.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
WHERE j.col_juliet = 0.75
GROUP BY j.col_papa
ORDER BY avg_hull_distance ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    z.col_quebec,
    d.col_luna,
    SUM(j.col_juliet * v.col_tango) AS ref_energy,
    d.col_luna - SUM(j.col_juliet * v.col_tango) AS corrected_enthalpy
FROM tbl_zulu z
JOIN tbl_delta d ON d.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
JOIN tbl_juliet j ON j.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
JOIN tbl_xray x ON j.col_papa = x.col_papa
JOIN tbl_victor v ON v.col_papa = x.col_papa
WHERE z.col_quebec = 'Co3Ti'
GROUP BY z.col_rhea, z.col_quebec, d.col_luna
ORDER BY corrected_enthalpy ASC
LIMIT 10000;

WITH corrected AS (
    SELECT
        tbl_zulu.col_quebec,
        tbl_delta.col_luna - SUM(tbl_juliet.col_juliet * tbl_victor.col_tango) AS corrected_formation_energy
    FROM tbl_delta
    JOIN tbl_zulu ON tbl_delta.col_rhea = tbl_zulu.col_rhea
    JOIN tbl_juliet ON tbl_juliet.col_rhea = tbl_zulu.col_rhea
    JOIN tbl_xray ON tbl_juliet.col_papa = tbl_xray.col_papa
    JOIN tbl_victor ON tbl_victor.col_papa = tbl_xray.col_papa
    WHERE tbl_delta.col_hotel = TRUE
      AND tbl_zulu.col_delta = 'L12'
    GROUP BY tbl_zulu.col_rhea, tbl_zulu.col_quebec, tbl_delta.col_luna
)
SELECT
    col_quebec,
    ROUND(corrected_formation_energy::numeric, 4) AS corrected_formation_energy_ev_per_atom
FROM corrected
WHERE corrected_formation_energy < -0.3
ORDER BY corrected_formation_energy ASC
LIMIT 10000;

WITH per_compound AS (
  SELECT
    ja.col_papa AS a_site,
    d.col_luna - SUM(jc.col_juliet * v.col_tango) AS rereferenced_formation_energy
  FROM tbl_zulu z
  JOIN tbl_delta d ON d.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
  JOIN tbl_juliet ja ON ja.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
  JOIN tbl_juliet jc ON jc.col_rhea = z.col_rhea
  JOIN tbl_xray x ON jc.col_papa = x.col_papa
  JOIN tbl_victor v ON v.col_papa = x.col_papa
  WHERE z.col_delta = 'L12'
    AND d.col_hotel = TRUE
    AND ja.col_zulu = 'a'
  GROUP BY ja.col_papa, z.col_rhea, d.col_luna
)
SELECT
  a_site_element,
  AVG(rereferenced_formation_energy) AS avg_rereferenced_formation_energy
FROM per_compound
GROUP BY a_site_element
ORDER BY a_site_element
LIMIT 10000;
